results.title: Princess for a Day
results.overview: A wealthy widower hires a small-town girl to live in his guesthouse and pretend to be a famous cartoon princess, in order to draw his little girl out of a deep depression, caused by the death of her mother.

Alice is 27 years old today. Even though she is suffocating a bit, she still lives with her parents and tends to live in her dreams to escape her dreary everyday life. After a psychedelic party on a factory roof, she has a serious drunken bike accident. Will this give her the courage to become an adult?

results.title: I Want It All
results.overview: In December 2025, the extraordinary artist Hildegard Knef would have celebrated her 100th birthday. Her life was shaped by numerous talents, an unshakeable will to succeed and the ability to keep pushing herself forward. This documentary sheds light on the life of the legendary actress and singer.

results.title: Labake Olododo
results.overview: Set against the rich backdrop of Yoruba tradition, a courageous woman rises against oppression in her community. As she fights for justice, she must navigate political schemes, betrayal, and the weight of tradition.

results.title: El Güero
results.overview: A man working for a U.S. company arrives in a coastal town in Mexico to supervise the construction of the first hotel in the area. He starts feeling uncomfortable as the townspeople express their frustration over the invasion of their beaches, until one night the confrontation reaches a breaking point.

results.title: Typisch Emil
results.overview: 90 years of Emil Steinberger - a film about courage, love and the tireless urge to constantly reinvent oneself.

results.title: Step Six
results.overview: Lewis Novak is a quiet mechanic who unexpectedly finds himself at a crossroads after his boss Russell ropes him into house-sitting his apartment. It isn’t long before an assassin comes knocking looking for Russell. Now Lewis must think on his feet in order to outwit a mysterious maintenance man and make it out of his boss’ apartment alive.

results.title: Aphelion
results.overview: An anxious young junkie trapped in a co-dependent relationship with her increasingly abusive partner must find the courage to escape before he goes too far.

results.title: Frem
results.overview: A man has second-thoughts about his relationship on a bikeride home.

results.title: L'euphonie
results.overview: A young man begins to hear a harmony of sounds leading him to a euphoric inner state.

results.title: Sakazuki
results.overview: Two agency assassins cross blades in an empty bar when they find they're on the same gig.

results.title: Die'ced: Reloaded
results.overview: Benny escapes an asylum on Halloween, masked as a scarecrow and hungry for blood. In 1980s Seattle, the hunt is on - and no one is safe.

results.title: Child
results.overview: Desperate to save their unborn daughter from fatal complications, an expectant couple turns to a mysterious midwife.

results.title: Quezon
results.overview: A historical drama focusing on Manuel L. Quezon years after the Philippine Revolution during the American occupation. When his fight for independence from the United States is put to the test, Quezon finds himself playing the brutal game of politics to outmaneuver his rivals — including Leonard Wood, Sergio Osmeña, and Joven Hernando. In Quezon’s relentless quest for power, he ultimately faces off with Emilio Aguinaldo in the 1935 presidential elections, using charm and favoritism as both weapons and currency, in a campaign that ultimately changes the face of Philippine politics and history.

results.title: Senpai Is an Otokonoko Movie: Sunshine After the Rain
results.original_title: 映画 先輩はおとこのこ あめのち晴れ
results.overview: During spring break, Saki visits her father and has a close encounter with a whale. / Makoto confronts a former classmate. Meanwhile, Saki must make a difficult decision. / Saki is upset after spending the day at her mother's house. Makoto, meanwhile, decides to take a step forward. / After much thought, Saki finally makes a decision.

results.title: The Dumpling Queen
results.overview: A biographical drama of Znag Jianhe, a woman who left her home in China for Hong Kong, where she eventually founded the renowned Chinese frozen dumpling company Wanchai Ferry.

results.title: Meanwhile
results.overview: Diana wakes up in her beach house when her ventilator fails. In an imaginary conversation with her father, Astor Piazzolla, she reveals what she could never tell him in life, until her final words reveal that she, too, has died.

results.title: Trophy
results.overview: A romantic adventure at a hunting villa in Karelia turns into a real nightmare for Lina. After being cruelly treated by her lover's brother, she becomes the victim of a deadly hunt.

results.title: Weekend
results.overview: Agnes travels to Stockholm to spend a weekend with a man that she’s only met once before. The next morning she wakes up alone, locked inside his apartment. As the hours pass, Agnes starts to realize that the reality of the situation is far from what she first imagined.
